maya: Heads-up — noticed reproducible divergence between `prefill` and `inflight` KV cache runs on the new int4 rollout.

maya: Quick summary: when we prefill long prompt (40k tokens) then resume, outputs match CPU baseline. But when we stream tokens and rely on inflight KV merge, we see token-level drift after ~3k new tokens.

maya: Minimal repro I ran on r-7b-int4-2026a: 
```bash
./repro.sh --model r-7b-int4-2026a --mode inflight --prompt tests/long_40k.txt --seed 42 --steps 3000
```
logs attached in thread.

sasha: Interesting. Do you have a diff of logits or just final text mismatch?

maya: I grabbed logits for layer 12 and 24 for the first 500 tokens after the divergence point. The KL at layer 24 spikes ~0.12 vs <0.002 before.

david: infra-bot shows these runs on gpu-nd-4 are using fused-kernel v2, scheduler=cbs. Could be kernel edge-case with streaming KV writes. infra-bot: build 2026.03.15-fused-k2 on node gpu-nd-4.

infra-bot: <@david> node gpu-nd-4 scheduled maintenance today 22:00 UTC (not related but FYI).

jordan: Can you paste a tiny diff of cached KV keys around the boundary? I want to check aliasing/stride.

maya: small excerpt (hex indices):
```
prefill.kv[...]: 0x1a2f,0x1a30,0x1a31,0x1a32
inflight.kv[...]: 0x1a2f,0x1a30,0x1a31,0x1a34
```
maya: See the last index changed (0x1a32 -> 0x1a34) which maps to a rotated RoPE phase multiplier mismatch.

sasha: That looks like an off-by-two in the write-back stride when merging windows. Might be a tile alignment bug introduced by the compacted KV layout for int4.

david: Could also be a prefetch reorder — we added an optimization to overlap fetch+write for inflight. If prefill uses a single contiguous write path, that wouldn't hit the reorder.

maya: Re-ran with `--no-overlap` and inflight results lined up with prefill. So disabling overlap removes divergence.

jordan: Great repro. Can you file a quick issue with logs + the small patch that diosabled overlap? Link it here.

maya: Filed: https://tracker.redwood/ML-2268 — includes `logs.tar.gz`, `kv-dump-{prefill,inflight}.json`, and the failing seed.

sasha: For short-term: add a runtime guard to disable overlapped write for quantized models with windowed KV enabled. We'll patch canary image.

david: I'll schedule canary deploy to dedicated test pool. infra-bot: canary started on pool:dedicated-kv-test at 1759880000.

maya: Thanks — adding observed KL plots to the ticket. If anyone wants to rerun repro: use the `--compare-prefill` flag in repro.sh to auto-dump diffs.

jordan: We'll triage and prioritize. Assigning to sasha for root-cause + fix. :+1:

sasha: On it. Will try to produce a minimal kernel-level reproducer and see if quant packing/alignment is the cause.

maya: TL;DR: inflight overlap optimization plus int4 compacted layout produced RoPE index skew on merge boundary; disabling overlap is a reliable mitigator.
